page_title: BAY 1-2 AUG | Bayern Munich v Augsburg 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Florian Exner has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
90+1' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Finn Dahmen stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
88' The referee signals a corner kick to Augsburg.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arthur Chaves trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marius Wolf (Augsburg).
85' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Min-Jae Kim and he is replaced by Felipe Chavez (Bayern Munich).
85' That's a well-taken pass by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
84' The ball spins to Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.

81' 1 - 2 Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) meets a perfect cross from Dimitrios Giannoulis deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces a low shot into the middle of the goal. The score has changed to 1:2.
79' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Leon Goretzka is replaced by Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich).
79' A substitution has been made. Hiroki Ito is replaced by Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich).
78' The attendance is 75000.

75' 1 - 1 Arthur Chaves (Augsburg) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
75' The ball is out of play. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.

75' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the right side of the goal, but Jonas Urbig denies him with a great save.
74' Here's the change. Elvis Rexhbecaj leaves the pitch and Yannik Keitel (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
74' Here is a change. Fabian Rieder is going off and Manuel Baum gives the last tactical orders to Mert Komur (Augsburg).
74' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
73' Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) picked up a yellow card from referee.
73' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Jonas Urbig.
72' A snap shot by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Jonas Urbig produces a good save to thwart him.
65' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
64' The substitution is prepared. Samuel Essende (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Anton Kade.
61' Substitution. Alphonso Davies makes his way off the pitch and Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) comes on as his replacement.
61' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) replaces Lennart Karl.
61' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just over the bar.
58' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) will deliver the corner kick.
58' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders.
57' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) prepares to take a corner kick.
53' Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
50' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) causes Jonas Urbig little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Bayern Munich have a corner.
45' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) controls a cross inside the box and sends a low drive towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort.

42' The ball is laid off to Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Finn Dahmen to make a decent save.
37' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
34' Now Bayern Munich have a corner.
34' Florian Exner blows his whistle after Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
31' Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) is able to continue to play.
29' The game is interrupted now, Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Bayern Munich get a corner.
26' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Finn Dahmen pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
25' Luis Diaz sends a lofted pass into the box, Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) shows good awareness to connect with it but blazes his shot high over the crossbar.
23' 1 - 0 Gooal! Michael Olise takes over corner duties. Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
23' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is about to take a corner kick.
21' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) tackles a bit over-zealously and Florian Exner blows for a foul.
17' Good work from Augsburg as they win a corner.
16' The Bayern Munich players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
4' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Florian Exner is introduced as the referee for today's match.
